text:
Powerful drumbeat that mimics military cadence, building with electric guitars
Pages blurred before my eyes
Letters dancing, wouldn't stay in line
Teachers saying "try again"
While my mind drew pictures they couldn't comprehend
Walking out those school doors
Feeling like a stranger on familiar shores
But there's a strength inside
That textbooks never knew
A different kind of smart
That only few break through
Found my purpose in camouflage green
Best shot they'd ever seen
Feet marching forward, head held high
Finally found where I belong
No more shadows, no more wrong
Standing tall under open sky
Counting cadence, keeping time
These numbers finally make sense in my mind
Breaking records on the field
My body knows the language my mind couldn't yield
Sergeant calls out "Top Gun"
For the first time in my life, I'm someone
Now there's pride behind my eyes
That classrooms never gave
A different kind of smart
That makes the others brave
Found my purpose in camouflage green
Best shot they'd ever seen
Feet marching forward, head held high
Finally found where I belong
No more shadows, no more wrong
Standing tall under open sky
Dreams of flying Blackhawks through the air
Reading manuals with a different kind of care
Every detail memorized with pride
The encyclopedia they call me now
The kid who couldn't read has somehow
Become the one they all rely on
Found my purpose in camouflage green
Best shot they'd ever seen
Feet marching forward, head held high
Finally found where I belong
No more shadows, no more wrong
Standing tall under open sky
Steady aim, steady heart
Finally found my part
Steady aim, steady heart
Finally found my start
